standaloneimage.alt: ProAssure strategy meeting with healthcare professionals

text.text:
2-minute read

Hospitals count on communication tools like Stryker’s enterprise workflow platform to help teams stay connected and deliver quality care. Like any software solution, these systems need regular upkeep to stay at their best, from routine updates and new user onboarding to database management, inventory tracking and more.

That’s where ProAssure comes in.

1. Expertise that matters

With ProAssure, you get Stryker-trained professionals who understand the system inside and out, including how it integrates with other tools and Stryker products. We work with your team remotely or on site, learn your goals and help align workflows so your platform performs the way you need it to. We’re your strategic partners, not just system administrators.

What this looks like
• Dedicated specialists who know your environment and priorities, and how the platform works with badges, applications and middleware
• Guidance that aligns communication workflows with clinical and operational goals

 

2. Day to day made simple

ProAssure helps with the tasks that often fall through the cracks. From software updates and database management to inventory tracking and utilization reporting, our team helps keep things moving. We support adoption, onboarding for new hires and everyday questions, so your teams can stay focused on what matters—patient care.

What this looks like
• Support for adoption, training and day-to-day performance
• Database management, software updates, inventory tracking and utilization reporting
• Remote or on-site help to resolve issues quickly as part of your team

 

3. Proactive over reactive

Don’t wait for problems to surface. ProAssure anticipates needs, identifies trends and helps address challenges before they disrupt care. We work with you to refine communication workflows and keep pace with your evolving goals.

What this looks like
• Ongoing review of system health and utilization patterns with informed recommendations
• Opportunities to optimize workflows across teams and departments as needs change

Get started

Talk with your Stryker representative to see how ProAssure can support your team. We’ll outline the right level of partnership and get you moving quickly, so your system stays ready for the important work you do every day.
